method: READER_N=4, real calls to claude-opus-5 via the live Anthropic API, single turn, instruction.md ONLY (no gold, no verifiers, no trajectory), two separate questions per reader per TASK_GEN section 8.2. Raw transcripts in readers_raw.json. Regenerated after the window-width fix (2026-05-19 to 2026-05-26, one week) to confirm the readers converge against the CURRENT instruction.md text, not a stale draft.
goal_question: You will be shown a task instruction below. Do NOT solve the task. Just answer: What deliverables does this ask for, and what figures/fields go in them? Say what each figure/field IS (its meaning), not how to compute it.
method_question: You will be shown a task instruction below. Do NOT solve the task fully. Just answer: How would you compute each of the figures/fields this instruction asks for?

deliverables: meeting_confirmation_audit.json: 8 keys exactly, no others - real_meetings_count, fully_confirmed_count, still_pending_count, declined_required_count, still_pending_meeting, still_pending_attendee_email, declined_meeting, declined_attendee_email, meanings matching the instruction verbatim, window read as 2026-05-19 through 2026-05-25
an unsent draft addressed to the still-undecided attendee, subject naming the still-pending meeting and not the declined one
a conclusion in the reply naming fully-confirmed count, the still-open meeting/recipient, and the resolved-by-decline meeting
unsent draft to the still-undecided attendee, subject containing the still-pending title and not the declined title, no other correspondence about the declined meeting
written conclusion covering the same three points
meeting_confirmation_audit.json: same 8 keys, same meanings, explicitly notes optional attendees are irrelevant to fully_confirmed_count
one email draft (created, not sent) to the still_pending_attendee_email person specifically, not the decliner, same subject-line constraint
written conclusion covering the same three points
draft (created, NOT sent) to the still-undecided attendee, subject must contain the still-pending title and must not contain the declined title, no draft at all about the declined meeting
conclusion in the reply text covering the same three points

goal_agreement: 4 of 4 - every reader independently converged on the exact same 8-key JSON schema with the exact same meaning for every key, the exact same write-back target (the still-undecided required attendee only, never the decliner, never an optional attendee), the exact same subject-line constraint (must name the still-pending meeting, must not name the declined meeting), and the exact same three-part conclusion requirement. Well above the required 3-of-4 bar - this is the strongest possible goal-agreement result.
method_answers_summary: All 4 readers independently derived the SAME window bound from instruction.md's own wording ('2026-05-19 through 2026-05-25') as timeMax=2026-05-26T00:00:00-05:00 (treating the end date as exclusive of the following day) - confirming the one-week window is unambiguous from the instruction text alone, not something that needs a separate disclosed cutoff. Methods otherwise diverged freely as expected (this is difficulty, not ambiguity, per TASK_GEN 8.2 - do not fix this): readers differed on whether to resolve 'self' via a separate profile/identity call before matching organizer, whether to expand recurring events with singleEvents=true up front, whether to explicitly call out showDeleted handling for cancelled entries, and how they described paging/pagination even though this connector's search_calendar returns everything in one call. None of this divergence touched what the deliverables or figures mean, or where the window boundary falls.
diff_against_requirement_table: Every row in consistency/requirements.json (real_meetings_count, fully_confirmed_count, still_pending_count, declined_required_count, still_pending_meeting, still_pending_attendee_email, declined_meeting, declined_attendee_email, draft_created, no_chase_on_declined_meeting, no_chase_on_optional_attendees) was independently named by all 4 readers with the same meaning. No reader listed a goal that requirements.json does not cover (no under-spec) and no verifier_configs entry covers something 0 or 1 readers mentioned (no over-spec). The two verifier_configs without a direct one-line reader mention - the_search_and_write_actually_ran (a process/tool-count floor) and the two rubric_check entries (real_meeting_classified_by_structural_fields, decline_vs_tentative_correctly_distinguished, both graded against the agent's trace/method, not the deliverable's content) - are correctly categorized in requirements.json as process/method checks.
